stemMd: What does “broader practical aim” refer to?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Increasing the number of seats regardless of audibility.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Eliminating all airflow from the building.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Reducing only the numerical reverberation value.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Enabling students throughout the room to understand lectures.

explanationMd: The measured target concerns one acoustic property, while the practical aim is usable speech understanding for students. The phrase names that user-level outcome rather than a single instrumental metric.

distractorRationale.e: Appearance is not the aim discussed.
distractorRationale.c: That is the narrower performance target.
distractorRationale.b: The engineers test the unit rather than adopting this extreme aim.
distractorRationale.a: Seating capacity is not the problem.
